name: Inventory workspace catalog, authoritative availability formula, stock lots, and mutations

planSteps.description: Navigate to /inventory on the PolarOps frontend
Verify Inventory Management workspace header 'Inventory Management - Polar supplies catalog, stock lots by facility, and immutable ledger' is visible
Verify item search input, category filter, and criticality filter dropdowns are present
Verify inventory catalog table renders item codes, names, categories, and criticality badges
Click on an inventory item row or inspect button to open the InventoryDetailPanel drawer
Verify drawer displays item specifications (category, criticality, unit of measure, temperature ranges, data provenance)
Verify authoritative availability indicator shows backend formula: available = on_hand - reserved - quarantined - damaged
Verify stock lots table lists active lots with lot numbers, locations, on-hand, and availability
Verify immutable transaction ledger table renders timestamp, type, quantity, balance after, and reference
Select RECEIVE tab in Lot Workflows, enter quantity and reference, and click Execute RECEIVE
Verify confirmation dialog appears with operation summary before submission
Confirm action and verify stock availability and transaction ledger update upon mutation completion
Verify negative input paths (e.g. non-positive quantities) are rejected with validation error
